web.app_body: It plays more kinds of video than a browser can, and can download them to watch offline. Free, like this web app.
web.coffee_card_note: TMPlayer is free for everyone. A coffee helps keep it that way.
web.coffee_hide: Hide the coffee button for now
web.coffee_setting_detail: A small button in the bottom corner that opens Buy Me a Coffee. Its x hides it until you next open TMPlayer; turn this off to hide it for good
web.gone_from_chat: This video is gone from the chat.
web.install_ios: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. TMPlayer then opens full screen, like an app.
web.install_ios_before_sign_in: Best done before you sign in: the Home Screen app keeps its own sign in.
web.install_ios_body: It opens full screen, like an app, and keeps your sign in and places.
web.install_ios_own_sign_in: The Home Screen app keeps its own sign in, so you sign in there once more.
web.install_ios_step_add: Choose Add to Home Screen, then Add
web.install_ios_step_share: Tap Share in the browser's bar
web.install_ios_title: Add TMPlayer to your Home Screen
web.install_pwa_body: It opens in its own window, and the browser keeps its data.
web.keep_storage: Keep TMPlayer's data in this browser
web.keep_storage_off: Off: when the device runs low on space, the browser may clear TMPlayer's data, which signs you out. Press to ask it to keep it
web.keep_storage_on: On: the browser keeps your sign in, settings and places even when the device runs low on space
web.keep_storage_refused: The browser did not agree. Installing TMPlayer to the home screen usually lets it keep the data
web.low_storage_always: Always on in a browser: a video is streamed and only the part being played is kept, in memory, never on the disk
web.needs_app_codec: Your browser cannot play this kind of video.
web.needs_app_format: Its format, {format}, does not open in a browser.
web.needs_app_no_mse: This browser is too old to convert it for playing. Safari 17 or later, or a recent Chrome or Firefox, can.
web.needs_app_picture: Its picture is {codec}, which this browser cannot decode.
web.needs_app_picture_subtitles: Its subtitles are pictures, which the browser cannot draw.
web.needs_app_title: This video needs the TMPlayer app
web.needs_app_too_heavy: It is too heavy to decode smoothly in this browser.
web.no_sound: This browser cannot play this video's sound ({codec}), so it plays without sound.
web.not_found: There is nothing at this address.
web.notify_allow_ask: Off in this browser. Press to let TMPlayer show its notifications while it is open in a tab
web.notify_allow_blocked: Blocked for this site. Allow notifications in the browser's site settings, then come back
web.notify_allow_on: On: TMPlayer shows its notifications while it is open in a tab, also when the tab is in the background
web.notify_allow_unsupported: This browser does not show notifications for web pages. On an iPhone or iPad, add TMPlayer to the Home Screen first
web.notify_episodes_detail: When a show you are watching posts its next episode, in a chat you can see, checked about every 45 minutes while TMPlayer is open in a tab
web.notify_new_videos_detail: A notification when a starred chat posts videos, checked about every 45 minutes while TMPlayer is open in a tab
web.notify_summary: New episodes, new videos and missing parts, while TMPlayer is open in a tab
web.offline: Offline. TMPlayer carries on once the connection is back.
web.other_tab_body: Only one tab can use your Telegram account at a time. Close the other tab, or use TMPlayer here instead.
web.other_tab_title: TMPlayer is open in another tab
web.posters_on_detail: Looked up on TMDB by each video's cleaned-up title. Nothing else is sent, no chat, file or account.
web.proxy_detail: Set in this device's or browser's network settings
web.proxy_unavailable: In a browser, TMPlayer reaches Telegram over the browser's own secure connection, which cannot go through a Telegram proxy. To use a proxy or a VPN, set it up in this device's or browser's network settings.
web.signout_body: You'll be signed out and taken back to the sign-in screen. Your favourites, your watched list and everything you were part way through go with it.
web.sound_unplayable: This browser cannot play the {codec} sound, so the sound stays as it was.
web.stopped_loading: The video stopped loading. Check your connection, then try again.
web.storage_body: Your sign in, settings and the parts of videos you played are kept in this browser only. Nothing goes to a server of ours.
web.storage_body_stream: Your sign in, settings and places are kept in this browser only, never on a server of ours. Videos are streamed: only the part playing is held, in memory.
web.storage_unavailable: This browser is not keeping TMPlayer's data, as in a private window. Your settings and places last until the tab closes.
web.storage_used: {used} used, of the {quota} this browser allows
web.switch_decoder: This browser could not play it directly, so TMPlayer is decoding it itself.
web.too_old_body: Update it, or open TMPlayer in Safari 16.4 or later, or a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox. The TMPlayer app runs on Android phones and TVs, Windows, macOS and Linux.
web.too_old_title: This browser is too old for TMPlayer
web.update_ready: A new version of TMPlayer is ready.
